title.en: An Act Providing for the Change of the Name of the Barrio of Cuting, in the Municipality of Pozorrubio, Province of Pangasinan, to Don Benito, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The name of the barrio of Cuting, municipality of Pozorrubio, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby
changed to Don Benito, and after the approval of this Act, all territory comprised in the jurisdiction of said
barrio of Cuting shall be called Don Benito, as herein provided.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1926.
